visualCharacteristics.purpose: Checkmarked benefit or eligibility list laid out in two (or more) columns

contentPattern.structure: One or more rows; each cell is a column holding a bulleted list (each item: bold label, optional description, optional link or info button). A cell without a list has each paragraph treated as one item. A single-cell list flows into two columns on desktop. Empty cells are dropped

reuseGuidance: Use for short feature/benefit/eligibility checklists. Use columns-text for side-by-side prose and table-striped for tabular comparisons
